source: Existing human-curated Movie Mood catalogue; anchors are calibration aids and may be corrected by later review.

anchors.rationale: Warm, generous comedy; funny is central without implying weightlessness as a universal rule.
Intensity and consequence create a sustained emotional cost.
Observational rhythm is patient, while its attention demand remains easy.
Language, time, and emotional construction reward sustained attention.
Relentless forward movement; fast does not itself mean every fast film is exciting.
Kinetic escalation and repeat-loop momentum are core to the experience.
Brisk stylized romance can carry three compatible moods without over-tagging.
Quiet contemplation and emotional intimacy are distinct but both central.
